_comment: Curated by hand from the research inbox. Paraphrased and trimmed. Not auto-exported: a note reaches this file only after a human or an agent has read it for private details.

notes.asked: Is the search engine image pinned in the repo?
notes.answer: Yes, pinned by digest. Then it flagged its own earlier advice: the command it had given me compares a local image ID, which never equals a registry digest. It gave the right 2 commands and 3 likely causes if they still differ.

notes.asked: Help me pick an offsite backup target.
notes.answer: Read the backup script first and found the offsite lane already built, waiting on 2 variables. Then priced 3 providers against the real 53 GB backup set. One costs about twice another at this size with no gain for a backup I rarely read.

notes.asked: Could I copy the stock trades that US Congress members disclose?
notes.answer: A weekend build from free official data. But across 17,859 disclosed trades, the median purchase trailed the S&P 500 by 5.36 points over a year, with or without the filing lag. Build it as a tracker if I want one. Leave my money out of it.

notes.asked: A viral diagram credits a famous researcher with a new agent stack. Real?
notes.answer: The diagram is a remix. The original write-up describes a notes pattern I already run and never mentions the product in the picture. Nothing supports the 10x and 80% claims on it.

notes.asked: A post says: use the new model's free window to build a website.
notes.answer: The offer is real, it said, and the website pitch is generic engagement bait. It pointed me at better uses of the window. I built the website anyway. You're on it.
